question.prompt: \(\triangle ABC\sim\triangle DEF\), with a similarity ratio of \(2:3\). The area of \(\triangle ABC\) is \(24\text{ cm}^2\). Find the area of \(\triangle DEF\). (Unit: cm²)

solutions.explanation: The area ratio is \(4:9\), so the area of \(\triangle DEF\) is \(24\times9/4=54\).
solutions.title: Use the squared area ratio
